title: Grade 3 French — Wed, Jun 03
description: Les couleurs — Day 3 of 5: Colours in nature and everyday objects
subject: french

questions.question: Answer 'De quelle couleur est le ciel?' (the sky)
questions.explanation: 'Le ciel est bleu.' = The sky is blue.

questions.question: Answer 'De quelle couleur est le soleil?' (the sun)
questions.explanation: 'Le soleil est jaune.' = The sun is yellow.

questions.question: What colour is 'une banane' (a banana)?
questions.explanation: 'La banane est jaune.' = The banana is yellow.

questions.question: What colour is 'le chocolat' (chocolate)?
questions.explanation: 'Le chocolat est marron.' = Chocolate is brown.

questions.question: What does 'vert foncé' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Foncé' = dark. 'Vert foncé' = dark green. ('Clair' = light, 'foncé' = dark.)

questions.question: What colour is 'la neige' (snow)?
questions.explanation: 'La neige est blanche.' = The snow is white. (Neige is feminine → blanche.)

questions.question: What colour are 'les feuilles en été' (leaves in summer)?
questions.explanation: 'Les feuilles sont vertes en été.' = Leaves are green in summer.

questions.question: Answer 'De quelle couleur est une fraise?' (a strawberry)
questions.explanation: 'La fraise est rouge.' = The strawberry is red.

questions.question: What does 'multicolore' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Multicolore' = multicoloured (many colours). 'Un arc-en-ciel est multicolore.' = A rainbow is multicoloured.

questions.question: What is 'un arc-en-ciel'?
questions.explanation: 'Un arc-en-ciel' = a rainbow (literally 'arc in the sky'). It has many couleurs.

questions.question: What colour is 'un corbeau' (a crow)?
questions.explanation: 'Le corbeau est noir.' = The crow is black.

questions.question: Complete: 'une orange est ___'
questions.explanation: 'Une orange est orange.' = An orange is orange. The fruit and colour share the word.

questions.question: An elephant 'gris' and a mouse 'grise' — what colour are both?
questions.explanation: Both are grey. 'Gris' (m. for éléphant) and 'grise' (f. for souris) both = grey.
